About This Auction

Online-Only Auction PROPERTY: Home on 5 Acres near Derby, Kansas AUCTION DATE: November 17th, 2026 at 6 PM CST L2 Realty, Inc. presents 5 acres of opportunity between Derby and southeast Wichita! Situated just off blacktop Greenwich Road and a short drive from McConnell Air Force Base, this property combines a convenient location with space to renovate, build, or expand. Featuring an approximately 1,800-square-foot earth-sheltered home, this property will be offered at online-only auction on November 17th, 2026. Location & Access: Enjoy acreage living with Derby and southeast Wichita close by! This location provides convenient access to shopping, dining, employment, and everyday services while offering room to spread out beyond a typical residential lot. Nearby Greenwich Road provides blacktop access to the surrounding area, and proximity to McConnell Air Force Base adds to the property's convenient position within the Wichita metro. Opportunity & Potential: Bring your ideas and explore the possibilities this 5-acre property offers. Fix up the existing home, explore building a new home, or consider adding a shop alongside the current residence. Whether your plans involve a renovation project or a different long-term vision for the acreage, the combination of location and usable space makes this a property worth a closer look. Earth-Sheltered Home & Acreage: Built in 1985, the existing home has custom architectural design and features 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, an attached garage, and approximately 1,800 square feet of living space. Its earth-sheltered design helps moderate indoor temperatures, supporting comfortable conditions through hot Kansas summers and cold winters while potentially reducing heating and cooling demands. A water well and yard irrigation system provide practical benefits for maintaining the grounds. Auction & Buyer Information: This property will be offered at online-only auction on November 17th, 2026. An inspection report will be available for potential buyers to review, providing an opportunity to learn more about the home's condition before bidding. The property is selling "as-is, where-is" with no contingencies. An open house is scheduled for November 8th from 12:00 p.m. to 2:00 p.m. Come walk the property, tour the home, and consider how the acreage could fit your plans. Property Highlights: - 5 acres between Derby and southeast Wichita - Just off blacktop Greenwich Road - Near McConnell Air Force Base - Approximately 1,800-square-foot earth-sheltered home - 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and an attached garage - Opportunity to renovate the existing home - Space to explore a new home or shop - Water well and yard irrigation system - Inspection report available for potential buyers - Online-only auction November 17th, 2026 - Open House November 8th, 12:00 p.m. - 2:00 p.m. Location, acreage, and the opportunity to make it your own! Call or email listing agent Tyler Gentry at (316) 751-6528 or tgentry@L2realtyinc.com for more information or to schedule a private showing.
